verdicts.rationale: Both Lyons, John, 'Semantics', 1977, Cambridge UP. A's title 'Semantics, vol' is a truncated volume marker; neither carries a distinguishing volume number. Same author/year/publisher (B adds ISBN). Same work.
Identical chapter 'Adverbs and adverbials', Maienborn & Schafer, 2011, de Gruyter, pages 1390-1420, in the HSK Semantics handbook. A carries the DOI. Clearly the same incollection.

A is Walton's 1990 book 'Mimesis as Make-Believe' (Harvard UP). B is a corrupted article entry: its journal field reveals it is actually Walton's 2002 JAAC article 'Depiction, Perception, and Imagination' (vol 60, pp 27-40), with the book title leaked into the title field. Different works.

Both Mandler 1984 'Stories, Scripts, and Scenes: Aspects of Schema Theory' (Erlbaum). B's title is truncated to 'Stories' with the subtitle 'Aspects of Schema Theory' leaked into the publisher field. Same book.

A is Markman's 1989 book 'Categorization and Naming in Children' (MIT Press). B is a 1989 journal article 'Categorization and Naming in Young Children: Problems in Induction' (Merrill-Palmer Quarterly, vol 39, pp 133-160). Different titles, different venues; book vs article.

Same pair as above reversed: A is the Merrill-Palmer Quarterly article 'Categorization and Naming in Young Children: Problems in Induction' (vol 39, pp 133-160); B is the MIT Press book 'Categorization and Naming in Children'. Different works.
Both Marr 1978 'Representing visual information' (Academic Press); B carries the fuller subtitle 'a computational approach'. Same author/year/publisher. Same work.

A is 'The role of attention in visual processing' (Maunsell & Cook, 2002, Phil Trans R Soc B, with DOI). B is 'The role of attention in visual cerebral cortex' (Maunsell, 2004, in 'The visual neurosciences', MIT Press). Different titles, years, and venues.

Both McCawley's University of Chicago Press book on logic for linguists. A has the full title 'Everything that linguists have always wanted to know about logic...'; B has the shortened variant 'What Linguists Have Always Wanted to Know about Logic...'. Year 1980 vs 1981 is within the same edition window. Same book.
Identical ISBN 9780262631129, same authors (Rumelhart, McClelland, and the PDP Research Group), same year 1987. Both 'Parallel Distributed Processing' (A adds '- 2 Vol. Set'). Same physical item.

A is the '2 Vol. Set' (ISBN 9780262631129). B is explicitly volume 1 ('volume: 1', ISBN 9780262181204) of PDP. Different ISBNs and set-vs-single-volume; merging would archive a distinct volume-level entry.

B (volume '1 and 2', DOI 10.7551/mitpress/5236) is the complete 2-volume set, matching A's '2 Vol. Set' at the work level, but A is an incollection with pages 77-109 (a chapter-level cite) and a different ISBN (9780262631129 vs 9780262181204). Chapter-vs-whole-set ambiguity makes a confident merge unsafe.

B is a corrupted misc entry (garbled 'journal: New York: IEEE', no ISBN) carrying the whole-set DOI 10.7551/mitpress/5236. A is the 2-vol set cited as an incollection chapter (pp 77-109). Whole-work vs chapter-level ambiguity plus B's corruption; not confident enough to merge.

A is the '2 Vol. Set' (ISBN 9780262631129). B is explicitly 'Parallel Distributed Processing, Vol. 1' (ISBN 9780262680530). Vol 1 is not the same as the complete set, and the ISBNs differ. Distinct volume-level entries.
Identical ISBN 9780262631129, same authors, same year 1987, both 'Parallel Distributed Processing' (B adds '- 2 Vol. Set'). Same physical item.
A (ISBN 9780262631129) vs B explicitly 'Parallel Distributed Processing, Vol. 1' (ISBN 9780262680530). B is a specific single volume with a different ISBN. Distinct entries.
A is the '2 Vol. Set' (ISBN 9780262631129). B is explicitly volume 1 ('volume: 1', ISBN 9780262181204). Set vs single volume with different ISBNs; distinct.

A is 'Parallel Distributed Processing - 2 Vol. Set' (book). B is volume '1 and 2' with the canonical MIT Press PDP set DOI 10.7551/mitpress/5236.001.0001 (book). Both denote the complete 2-volume PDP work; the ISBN difference reflects different printings of the same set. Same work.

A is the '2 Vol. Set' (book). B carries the whole-set DOI 10.7551/mitpress/5236.001.0001 for the complete PDP work; its misc type and garbled fields are metadata-quality artifacts. Both denote the whole 2-volume PDP work. Same work.
A is the '2 Vol. Set' (ISBN 9780262631129). B is explicitly 'Parallel Distributed Processing, Vol. 1' (ISBN 9780262680530). Complete set vs a single volume with distinct ISBN; distinct entries.
